title: Spectral Inspection
summary: A focused workspace for tonal balance, spectral history, and low-end detail.
descriptionMarkdown: Inspect the first available channel pair across complementary frequency and time views. Full Spectrum keeps a decaying maximum trace for overall tonal balance, while Low End Detail isolates 20–250 Hz with Max Hold and Peak Labels. Spectrum History and a frequency-coloured Waveform align persistent energy with programme structure. The Preset keeps Loudness Profile and Dock off and does not imply a universal target curve.

releases.notesMarkdown: Refresh previews for the current PLVS interface. Preset settings are unchanged from Release 1; existing Library items do not need to be imported again.
